title: The power gate is a step function on final damage
body: Team power divided by the stage's recommended power picks a bracket, and the bracket multiplies final damage: under 10% keeps 1%, from 10% 5%, from 20% 15%, from 40% 35%, from 60% 55%, from 80% 75%, from 100% 100%, and from 120% 120% (the cap). There is no interpolation between steps, so 39.9% of recommended power fights at 15% and 40.0% at 35%. The community names a bracket by the damage it keeps: '35% 단' means pushing at 40–59% of recommended power, '15%' at 20–39%. The multiplier comes last in crumblehub's damage formula, after defence, element, boss damage and crit.

title: What the gate does not touch
body: The multiplier applies only to the damage your team deals. Boss damage to your team is unchanged ('보스의 피해량에는 영향을 미치지 않습니다'), your stats keep rising past the 120% cap, and PvP's equivalent correction is fixed at 100%. The same bracket table applies to the daily dungeons, the Implant Tower and the Dimensional Rift.

title: Team power is the formation's displayed power, and it can be padded
body: The gate reads the power shown on the formation screen, which includes gear, sugar runes, plates, guild membership and pets. Players pad it: gear is chosen 'purely for power' (뻥투) once the bracket is what's missing; crit resist lines inflate displayed power (the same cape shows 3.99M with a crit-resist line against 2.82M without); SSR sugar-rune lines that raise power are kept until the Rift (about +3–4M each, 30–66M over a team); leaving a guild dropped one player from 35% to 15%. Being 0.6M short of the 40% line (971.8M against 972.5M at 271-11) fought at 15%.

title: Accuracy and focus are a second gate per stage
body: Each stage has an accuracy requirement (from enemy evasion) and a focus requirement (from enemy resistance). At the requirement attacks hit 100% and debuffs land at their listed chance; below it they miss. In game data 1.4.002 the accuracy requirement stops rising at 1,203.5 from about chapter 248 to 328-30, while focus keeps rising to 1,161.5 at 328-30. A poster measured about 10% more misses per 100 accuracy short, and 950 accuracy gave about 79% hits at 270-18 before the easing.

title: How much accuracy the pushers actually run
body: Before the 2026-09-23 easing, 35% pushers wanted 1,000–1,100+ accuracy and warned that dropping from 1,150 to 930 broke clears around chapter 250. After the easing the targets fell: 900 accuracy is called enough all the way to 328, the top player ND러너 puts it at 900–1,000 for stages and 1,000+ past 300, and 1,300 is wasted. Focus matters for debuffers (Dark Choco, Scorpion's shred) rather than for damage: 'drop Dark Choco's focus and it's an empty can'. At 15% and in the Rift, accuracy and focus matter more because every miss costs a larger share of the damage you have.

title: The 2026-09-23 easing lowered recommended power and enemy stats
body: Update 1.4.002 eased main stages 169-1 to 328-30 and rebalanced the bosses of 169-1 to 248-30 (Cool Mint, Rowdy Biker, Rowdy Truck, GingerCraven, Cream Eagle, Tainted Ent, Redberry Assassin, Choco Werehound Princess). Recommended power, enemy ATK and HP dropped from almost nothing at 169-1 to about 30% at 248-30 (2.00G → 1.40G) and 36% at the end (328-30: 15.61G → 10.00G). Accuracy requirements didn't change (248-30 stayed at 1,203). One player's 55% reach moved from chapter 257 to 273 overnight.

title: Chapters cycle through eight zones with fixed boss slots
body: Chapter c belongs to zone ((c − 1) mod 8) + 1: grassland, beach, ruined city, desert, mushroom zone, plaza, lava zone, snowfield. From chapter 169 every chapter of a zone has the same 30-stage layout, so the bosses sit in fixed slots: the -30 stage is Cool Mint in grassland, beach and plaza, GingerCraven (비겁한 쿠키) in the ruined city and snowfield, the Ginkgoblin Stormer in the desert, the Tainted Ent in the mushroom zone and the Magma Sugar Waffle Lizard in the lava zone. The ruined city's -10 is three Rowdy Bikers and its -20 the Rowdy Truck; the plaza's -10 is a pack of ten Redberry Assassins and its -20 the Choco Werehound Princess (망치공주). The other slots are mob stages, several with ten enemies.

title: GingerCraven (비겁이) is the wall at every bracket
body: The ruined-city and snowfield -30 boss flees, fears the team and outlasts low damage: it is the stage the community names when a bracket stops working ('비겁이 컷'). Before the easing it needed 35% at best and many pushers took it at 55% with padded power; attempts at 15% failed (256-30 at 980M left it at 41% after an hour; another 15% attempt removed about 20% of its HP), while the same player cleared it first try at 35%. Players bring a dedicated deck with Scorpion, Lime or Tiger Lily, Ion and damage-reduction perks and pets. When a 35% attempt keeps failing, the guides' advice is to swap filler support for power (GingerBright → Pinot Noir, Grapevine → Brightseeker) until the team reaches 55%, and clear within about 20 tries instead of retrying for hours at 35%.

title: Launch bosses: bring Panda Dumpling
body: Cool Mint, the Werehound Princess, the Tainted Ent and King Choco Drop launch (띄우기) the team. The fix is a pet swap, not a deck change: put Panda Dumpling (판다만두) in the third pet slot, even at low level, for its Lift RES and HP. Cool Mint is fought in a corner (7 or 11 o'clock).

title: Redberry Assassin and the truck need hands
body: The plaza's Redberry Assassin packs wipe and scatter; ND러너 still hates them at 35% after the easing and swaps two melee cookies for Jungle Warrior or Tiger Lily and Rye, luring the pack to the 6 o'clock stairs. An area-damage rapid-fire deck is the alternative. The Rowdy Truck is kited in circles at 7 or 9 o'clock until the team's first heal (about 26 s in), then left to auto.

title: Where 15% works and where it doesn't
body: Documented 15% clears are mob stages and weak bosses: 271-11 (a Lava Waffle Lizard pack) at 971.8M on auto-era gear, and 301-27/301-28 at 2.05G on an all-power gear preset, played by hand with a Brightseeker, Princess Bari and Cherry Cola deck. The -30 bosses, bikers, truck, eagle and Redberry packs are reported as walls at 15%; GingerCraven at 15% is 'nearly impossible'. A claim of 328-30 at 'just over 3G' with Bari 9★ and Cherry Cola 10★ has no screenshot.

title: After the easing, 35% pushes to 328-30
body: Since 2026-09-23 the 35% bracket clears everything to the end: 328-30 (GingerCraven) at 4.00G, 4.06G and 4.2G, 312-30 at 2.74G, and 266-30 Cool Mint on auto at 1.17G. The 35% line at 328-30 is 4.00G (40% of 10.00G). Players now lose to damage rather than survival, so tanks and Herb leave the deck for damage and Rockstar.

title: Push, then park at the highest clear
body: Offline (idle) rewards depend on the stage you are parked on, so the loop is: push until stuck, park on the highest cleared stage, reinvest, push again. Guides treat about 55% of recommended power as a realistic manual target and about 35% as the point to stop and farm; tryhards push at 35% and on mob stages at 15%. Enabling boss auto-summon (자동 소환 예약) lets a deck retry a boss indefinitely on auto: one 264-30 clear came after 30 minutes of manual attempts and then unattended retries.

title: Dimensional Rift: rules
body: Unlocked by clearing 328-30. Seasonal (season 1: 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-08, levels 1–100; later seasons use 101–200) and boss-only: normal mobs are skipped and each level is one boss fight. Recommended power starts at 10.00G (level 1) and reaches about 1,800G at level 100. A Rift-only growth stat, 차원의 힘 (Dimensional Energy), fills per minute while you are in the Rift and raises ATK, DEF and HP amplification, crit, accuracy and focus inside the Rift only; displayed power inflates with it (4.0G to 8.05G by 차원의 힘 Lv.4; ND러너 showed 22G against about 5G real). Rewards: per-level clears (a profile frame at 10; ND러너 names pet rewards at 1 and 20), a shop paid in 차원의 조각 (Dimension Fragments, about 3 a minute), and daily and season rankings across all servers.

title: Dimensional Rift: the power gate applies
body: The bracket table applies in the Rift, measured against the Rift level's recommended power and the Rift-inflated team power. ND러너: 'treat every Rift level as a 35% fight'; the Rift is built so that each level becomes clearable once enough 차원의 힘 has stacked. With maximum DEF shred the other bosses fall at 15%, but GingerCraven needs 35%. One poster felt no penalty; four others and the top player say it applies.

title: Dimensional Rift: bosses and tech
body: Only a few boss types repeat in fixed patterns: level 3 the Werehound Princess, 4 the Rowdy Truck, 5 and 15 GingerCraven, 6 the Cake Hound Pack, 9 three trucks, 100 GingerCraven. Bosses come with adds from both sides. Tech from the top guilds: stack Scorpion's poison to 20 and DEF shred to 10, add Dark Choco and Devil against the truck, pull the boss to 7 or 9 o'clock, and give a level about five tries: if 20–30% of its HP comes off keep trying, else park and level 차원의 힘. The Rift's entrance has its own Charge buff, and Octo Wasabi (와사비 문어) is the favoured pet. The Rift-exclusive SSR pet 무한바퀴 raises boss damage in the Rift.
